note: Media Crowdriff is a core-Media integration with no settings form, no configure route (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, and no config schema. It defines a media source plugin (id media_crowdriff, allowed_field_types string_long, auto source field field_media_media_crowdriff), a Media Library add form (MediaCrowdriffMediaForm), a validation constraint (id media_crowdriff, regex /(cr-init__|cr__init-)[a-z0-9]{8,}/), and a field formatter (id media_crowdriff, for string_long, settings width=100%/height=900px) that renders the media_crowdriff theme hook emitting an async <script src=https://starling.crowdriff.com/js/crowdriff.js>. All medium/hard cases are grounded in real media types/entities/view-displays created with that source and formatter.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site with the media_crowdriff module enabled, how do I let editors embed Crowdriff galleries as reusable media? Describe what to create and which media source to pick.
evals.expected_output: Create a new Media type (Structure > Media types > Add) and choose 'Media Crowdriff' (source plugin id media_crowdriff) as its Media source. Core auto-creates a string_long source field (field_media_media_crowdriff). Editors then add assets via the Media Library, pasting the Crowdriff embed code.

evals.prompt: The media_crowdriff module validates the Crowdriff embed code an editor pastes. What must the pasted code contain for it to be accepted, and what enforces that?
evals.expected_output: The media_crowdriff validation constraint (MediaCrowdriffConstraintValidator) requires the value to match the regex /(cr-init__|cr__init-)[a-z0-9]{8,}/ - i.e. contain a Crowdriff id like cr-init__abcd1234. Empty values fail with 'The embed code cannot be empty.'; non-matching values fail with the invalid-code message.

evals.prompt: Which field formatter does media_crowdriff provide for displaying a Crowdriff embed, what settings does it expose, and what are their default values?
evals.expected_output: The 'Media Crowdriff' formatter (id media_crowdriff, for string_long fields) exposes Width and Height settings (CSS units), defaulting to width=100% and height=900px. It extracts the Crowdriff id and renders the media_crowdriff theme hook (the async crowdriff.js loader script).

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a media type named mc_probe_type. Inspect the live configuration and report which media source plugin it uses and the machine name of its source field.
evals.expected_output: mc_probe_type uses the media_crowdriff source plugin; its source field is field_media_media_crowdriff (string_long).

evals.prompt: This site has a Crowdriff media asset named mc_probe_asset (media type mc_asset_type). Inspect the live media entity's source field and report the Crowdriff embed id it contains.
evals.expected_output: The mc_probe_asset media entity's field_media_media_crowdriff value contains the Crowdriff id cr-init__abcd1234 (stored inside its embed code).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a media type with machine id mc_task_type that uses the Media Crowdriff source, and give it a working string_long source field. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A MediaType mc_task_type exists with source plugin media_crowdriff and a string_long source field (field_media_media_crowdriff), e.g. MediaType::create([...'source'=>'media_crowdriff']) then createSourceField()->save() and set source_configuration.source_field.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the media type mc_fmt_type uses the Media Crowdriff source and displays its embed with the Media Crowdriff formatter. Configure that formatter on the default view display so the Crowdriff embed renders at width 640px and height 480px. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.media.mc_fmt_type.default the field_media_media_crowdriff component uses type media_crowdriff with settings.width=640px and settings.height=480px.
